description: For each Orb Studio radar: hourly means, the radar's mean and usual spread from its history before the last 48 hours, and the accumulated sum of deviations over the last 48 hours (CUSUM, the cumulative form of the control chart). Verdicts collecting, in_control, shift_up, shift_down with the time the shift began and the estimated new level. Complements radar jumps (big moves) and Nelson runs (run length). Thresholds are working assumptions checked on stored history. Rule-based, no AI. In honour of Walter A. Shewhart (1891-1967), author of the control chart.
name: get_shewhart
title: Shewhart sensor: has a radar's level quietly shifted (a small but lasting change, not a jump)
